## Claim and scope
What does this change establish? What does it deliberately **not** establish?

## Source and provenance
Cite the source, exact revision, and your permission/license to contribute this material.

## Tests and evidence
List frozen synthetic inputs, verifier, expectations, negative results, and `UNKNOWN`/uncertainty.

## Disclosure review
- [ ] No secrets, private data, internal endpoints, or private correspondence.
- [ ] No cross-system authority or live integration.
- [ ] No claim of endorsement or ratified partnership.
- [ ] License compatibility or explicit reason this is discussion-only.

## Rollback or correction
How can a mistaken result or claim be identified, challenged, and corrected?
